question: By what means is a result attained, according to this address?
premises: An address is made to one fair-faced.
Attainment is said to occur by this means.
That knowledge is also what has been heard.
inference: By mere knowledge, and by what has been heard, attainment occurs.
uncertainties: Nature of the attained result not specified.
plain_english: By this mere knowledge, and by what has been heard, O fair-faced one.
